'''2008 New York State Championship Alex Levine LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Alex Levine]] at [[2008 New York State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
